method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500: AI concerns weigh on equities – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Early Morning Reid note reports that US equities have broken a nine-day winning streak as higher Oil prices, hawkish Fed pricing and negative AI news hit risk sentiment.
Equities.reason: Concise market-level narrative: AI-related headlines + hawkish Fed repricing and oil moves are driving a risk-off impulse that snapped the S&P’s win streak — clear negative for broad equities.

Equities.title: Stocks slide on flare-up in Middle East fighting; oil eases off highs
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shock to risk sentiment: fresh Middle East clashes lift oil/uncertainty and push equities lower — meaningful negative for risk assets and market breadth.

Equities.title: Broadcom tumbles as revenue miss clouds AI boom bets
Equities.reason: Bellwether tech/AI name missed revenue and triggered a sharp sell-off — this undermines the AI leadership narrative and amplifies sector & market downside.

Equities.title: Why we're raising our price target on Broadcom despite its post-earnings sell-off
Equities.summary: Broadcom's AI business will continue to shine and outpace the conservative forecast.
Equities.reason: Analyst/upbeat counterpoint: supports longer-term AI thesis for Broadcom but limited near-term market transmission — modest positive, lower relevance versus the miss/sell-off.

Equities.title: CrowdStrike narrowly beats estimates on AI tailwinds, but stock falls 10%
Equities.summary: CrowdStrike shares have rallied nearly 60% this year on skyrocketing demand for cybersecurity in the age of advanced artificial intelligence.
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic beat but negative price action: reflects profit-taking/rotation in high-flyers and short-term sensitivity of AI beneficiaries to sentiment — modest negative for tech momentum.

Equities.title: SoftBank shares plunge over 11% amid broader tech sell-off
Equities.summary: Shares of SoftBank fell 11% following an overnight sell-off in the U.S. market on the back of wider profit taking in the tech sector.
Equities.reason: Regional/tech bellwether weakness tied to U.S. tech profit-taking — reinforces cross-market tech risk-off and liquidity-driven selling pressure.

Equities.title: Foreigners Offload Japanese Stocks as AI Bubble Worries Grow
Equities.reason: Cross-border flow signal: foreign selling tied to AI bubble concerns signals risk-aversion and potential de-risking away from equity markets — negative for regional equity demand.

Equities.title: Private payrolls grew by 122,000 in May, stronger than expected, ADP reports
Equities.summary: Unlike prior months, where job growth was concentrated in healthcare and a few other sectors, gains were more broad-based.
Equities.reason: Stronger-than-expected payrolls increase odds of persistent Fed hawkishness — a macro headwind for equities via tighter financial conditions.

Equities.title: TSMC boss bets big on AI growth, says he’d ’like’ to hike chip prices
Equities.reason: Positive supply/demand signal from a major chip supplier supports the structural AI-led growth narrative for semis — supportive for sector leadership and equities tied to AI.

Equities.title: SpaceX pitches investors $1.78tn valuation in historic IPO
Equities.summary: Rocket and AI group is seeking to raise up to $86bn in biggest Wall Street debut of all time
Equities.reason: Major IPO event: large-cap tech/AI supply and investor appetite story that can influence market sentiment and capital flows — modest positive but limited immediate market-wide impact.

Equities.title: Partners Group prepares to cap withdrawals at US fund for wealthy individuals
Equities.summary: Swiss group faces increasing strains as redemption requests from investors rise
Equities.reason: Liquidity/redemption pressures in private funds could signal broader risk aversion and potential forced selling or tighter risk premia — modest negative for equities sentiment.

Rates.title: BoJ to raise interest rates at June meeting – Reuters
Rates.summary: According to sources, the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will raise interest rates in the June policy meeting, Reuters reports. The report also states that the central bank is leaning towards pausing or slowing the pace of its bond-buying taper from Fiscal 2027.
Rates.reason: A BoJ rate hike is a clear hawkish shock for JGBs and global rates: it implies higher Japanese yields, reduced central bank bond purchases or slower taper (less demand), and raises the chance of upward pressure on global yields. High market importance given BoJ's long-standing easing stance.

Rates.title: Switzerland Consumer Price Index rises slower than estimates: What the stable inflation growth means for Swiss Franc?
Rates.summary: Switzerland Consumer Price Index (CPI) rises at a steady pace of 0.6% Year-on-Year (YoY) in May, but slower than the estimates of 0.8%. On a monthly basis, inflationary pressures grew moderately by 0.2% vs. estimates and the previous reading of 0.3%.
Rates.reason: Headline Swiss CPI softer than expected suggests lower-for-longer pressure on SNB policy and a modest decline in Swiss sovereign yields — supportive for Swiss bond prices. Event-level domestic rates relevance is direct but geographically contained.

Rates.title: Indian Rupee trades flat despite India scrapping capital gains tax on government bonds
Rates.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday after a strong Wednesday. The USD/INR pair holds onto the previous day’s gains around 95.72 even as the Indian administration decides to scrap capital gains tax on overseas investment i
Rates.reason: Removing capital gains tax on government bond holdings (particularly for non-residents) is likely to boost foreign demand for Indian government bonds, putting downward pressure on yields. This is a policy-driven flow story with clear implications for domestic rates and EM portfolio flows.

Rates.title: Indonesia passes sweeping bill expanding central bank role to spur growth
Rates.reason: Legislation expanding the central bank's role to actively spur growth can be perceived as a shift toward looser fiscal-monetary interaction or reduced central-bank independence, which can raise inflation and risk premia — upward pressure on yields (negative for bond prices). Regional/EM significance

Rates.title: BofA Says Foreign Buyers Lured by UK Yields Despite Politics
Rates.reason: Foreign demand attracted by higher UK yields is a direct, constructive flow into gilts that should compress yields. Cross-border buying is a material driver of gilt market performance and liquidity dynamics, making this a relevant rates-positive story.

Rates.title: High Yields Lured UK Money From Cash Funds to Bonds Last Month
Rates.reason: Flows shifting from cash to bonds indicate domestic investor demand for duration and income, supportive for gilt prices and lower yields. Reinforces the UK bond-demand narrative (complements the BofA piece) but slightly lower standalone market impact.

Rates.title: New Zealand Bond Auction Draws Record Demand After Issuance Cuts
Rates.reason: Record demand at a sovereign auction following issuance cuts is a clear rates-positive signal: strong primary demand supports secondary bond prices and suggests downward pressure on yields. Market-significant within the NZ rates market and relevant for local curve dynamics.

FX.title: US Dollar: Supported by higher yields and Fed repricing – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that Brent Oil prices remain elevated as US–Iran tensions persist, helping to support the US Dollar. Strong US data, including ADP employment and ISM services, reinforce expectations of a “higher for longer” Fed stance.
FX.reason: Clear USD-positive macro narrative: stronger US data, higher yields and Fed repricing support USD strength — a broad FX driver affecting major pairs.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Pressured by wider spreads versus US Dollar – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale strategists note USD/JPY trading just below 160 as hawkish comments from BoJ Governor Ueda fail to support the Japanese Yen (JPY). They highlight a sharp rebound in the 2-year UST/JGB spread and warn that a break higher in yields could extend
FX.reason: JPY-specific FX piece showing yen under pressure from widening UST/JGB spreads and yield-driven USD strength — high relevance given intervention/160 level dynamics.

FX.title: The BoJ signals a hike: Why the Japanese Yen may finally find support
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is hovering around the critical 160.00 threshold against the US Dollar, keeping markets on high alert for official currency interventions.
FX.reason: Potential BoJ policy shift is a regime signal that could restore JPY strength vs USD; important counter-narrative to prevailing USD/JPY weakness and intervention risk.

FX.title: Traders Brace for Big Yen Swings on BOJ, Intervention Risks
FX.reason: Market-focused Bloomberg report highlighting large yen volatility and ongoing intervention risk; reinforces USD/JPY pressure narrative and potential for abrupt FX moves.

FX.title: Asia Steps Up Currency Defense as Korea, Indonesia Vow Action
FX.reason: Regional central-bank/official FX defence is a direct transmission into FX: indicates broad EM/Asia weakness vs USD and policy activity to limit currency falls — high relevance.

FX.title: Dollar clings to 2-month high as Gulf hostilities flare, yen wobbles near intervention zone
FX.reason: Concise market-wire confirming USD at multi-week highs on geopolitical risk and yen intervention concerns — reinforces dominant USD-strength / safe-haven flow theme.

FX.title: Euro: Fed risks and energy-driven pressures – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team notes that stronger US data and rising energy prices are supporting the US Dollar and weighing on EUR/USD. The bank highlights Fed member Logan’s concern that higher rates may be needed later in 2026 and maintains a forecast for Fed hikes
FX.reason: Bank research tying EUR weakness to US-rate and energy dynamics — supports the USD-strength cross-asset narrative affecting EUR/USD.

FX.title: Euro holds above one-week low vs softer USD; upside seems limited as Iran risks persist
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair sticks to modest intraday gains through the first half of the European session, albeit it lacks follow-through buying and remains close to a one-week low touched earlier this Thursday.
FX.reason: Intraday EUR/USD note showing limited EUR upside and guarded recovery; relevant as a near-term counterbalance but lower relevance vs macro drivers.

FX.title: British Pound: Pressure building below 1.3390 versus US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report that GBP/USD has turned lower after failing to sustain gains above 1.3470. Short‑term momentum is now skewed to the downside, with scope for a test of 1.3405 and rising risk of a break below 1.3390 if the pair stays
FX.reason: GBP technical note showing renewed downside vs USD — supports the broader USD-strong/major-currencies-weak theme, but single-currency technicals limit relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Drop as US-Iran Clashes Keep Inflation Risks in Focus
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical tensions (US–Iran clashes) keep inflation and safe‑haven demand in focus, a supportive macro narrative for gold. Bloomberg coverage is market‑relevant and reinforces the broader safe‑haven theme.

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to modest recovery gains; bulls lack conviction amid Fed hike bets, Iran risks
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) trims part of its modest intraday gains and remains well within striking distance of a one-week low, touched the previous day. The Israel-Lebanon truce prompts some profit-taking around the US Dollar (USD) and supports the commodity.
Commodities.reason: Near‑term technical/intraday note: truce reduces USD safe‑haven flows slightly, giving modest support to gold. Classified as price/technical commentary so relevance capped.

Commodities.title: Gold: Central bank demand resumes – ING
Commodities.summary: ING notes that central banks returned to net buying of Gold in April after March’s net sales, citing World Gold Council data.
Commodities.reason: Structural demand signal: central bank net buying resumes, a material fundamental driver for gold prices and the dominant supportive narrative for the metal.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas storage capacity increased slightly in 2025
Commodities.summary: Underground working natural gas storage capacity in the Lower 48 states increased slightly in 2025, according to our latest data, with growth concentrated in the South Central and Mountain regions. Underground natural gas storage provides a source of energy wh
Commodities.reason: Small increase in storage capacity augments supply/stock flexibility for US gas, a mild negative for natural gas price pressure; EIA data is supply‑side and market‑relevant.

Commodities.title: Natural gas for power generation flat this summer, record high expected in 2027
Commodities.summary: We forecast natural gas consumption by the U.S. electric power sector this summer will remain near recent highs and set a record next summer in our May Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO). Despite a 2% increase in overall U.S. electricity demand this summer, we e
Commodities.reason: Demand outlook: power‑sector gas use near highs this summer and setting a record next year supports forward gas demand and prices; EIA STEO demand signal is market‑relevant.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD struggles below $74 amid geopolitical woes
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) ticks higher on Thursday, but maintains its bearish near-term tone intact, with upside attempts capped below the $74.00 area, and on track for a four-week decline.
Commodities.reason: Near‑term technical/price forecast indicating continued bearish tone for silver; treated as lower‑relevance price commentary within precious metals.

Commodities.title: Copper: Pullback on macro and tariff risks – ING
Commodities.summary: ING's Commodities Strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey report that Copper prices fell back below $14,000/t after a recent rally, as rising US–Iran tensions and macro concerns weighed on demand expectations.
Commodities.reason: Macro and trade/tariff concerns weighing on demand expectations create a negative impulse for copper; ING note is a relevant demand‑driven headwind for industrial metals.

Commodities.title: Soybeans Fall on Tuesday, as Traders Look Past Weaker Ratings for Wetter Forecast
Commodities.reason: Crop markets: short‑term bearish price move for soybeans as traders focus on weather updates; relevant to agricultural supply/demand but an idiosyncratic day move.

Commodities.title: The United States is a major energy exporter and importer, especially for petroleum
Commodities.summary: Total energy exports from the United States reached a record 31 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) in 2025, 2% more than the previous record set in 2024. U.S. energy imports were 21 quads, down 5% from 2024. Taken together, net trade—total imports less
Commodities.reason: Record US energy exports (including petroleum) point to tighter global supply balances versus prior years, a modest positive for oil/gas fundamentals; EIA data is broadly market‑relevant but not specific to one contract.

Commodities.title: Deadly Screwworm Parasite Found in US Threatens Cattle Herd
Commodities.reason: Supply shock risk for US cattle from a livestock‑disease outbreak is a materially bullish fundamental for live cattle prices; Bloomberg report is high‑signal for agricultural supply concerns.

Commodities.title: Most planned natural gas pipeline capacity additions in 2026 and 2027 originate in Texas
Commodities.summary: Developers plan to bring approximately 44.9 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of new pipeline capacity online in the United States in 2026 and 2027, according to our latest Natural Gas Pipeline Projects Tracker. Approximately 70% (31.6 Bcf/d) of this new capa
Commodities.reason: Large planned pipeline additions increase takeaway capacity and potential supply flexibility, a meaningful negative structural signal for regional gas tightness/pricing.

Commodities.title: Mexican sugar producers push to scrap US import quotas
Commodities.reason: Policy move that could increase sugar flows into the US if quotas are scrapped, a negative for domestic sugar price support; relevant to sugar fundamentals though initially policy‑specific.

Commodities.title: Corn Faces Weakness on Tuesday
Commodities.reason: Short‑term bearish technical/market commentary for corn; relevant to agricultural pricing but treated as lower‑impact day‑move.

Commodities.title: Russia Spring Wheat Planting Continues to Lag on Poor Weather
Commodities.reason: Delayed planting in a major exporter (Russia) risks tightening supply and is a bullish fundamental for wheat; Bloomberg report is market‑relevant and elevates agricultural supply concerns.

Crypto.title: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP ETFs bleed $4.4 billion over 13 sessions, only HYPE in green
Crypto.reason: Large sustained ETF outflows across major crypto ETFs indicate materially weaker institutional/inflow demand — broad negative for crypto prices and liquidity; high relevance given ETF scale and multi-session bleed.

Crypto.title: Grayscale launches lowest-fee U.S. Hyperliquid ETF as competition heats up around HYPE
Crypto.reason: New low-fee ETF product expands institutional product set and competition, supportive for adoption of tokenized crypto ETFs (positive but narrow to product-level demand).

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's high-conviction holders are turning into sellers as the crypto's price hits new lows
Crypto.summary: In the past two days, bitcoin's highest-conviction holders have sold about $2.4 billion in bitcoin.
Crypto.reason: Large-scale selling by long-term/high-conviction holders is a clear demand-side negative and raises probability of continued downside; meaningful but somewhat idiosyncratic to BTC holder behavior.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin briefly drops below $62,000 as $1.5 billion in crypto longs get wiped out
Crypto.reason: Large, abrupt long liquidations and a fresh multi-month low signal sharp deleveraging and forced selling — high-impact negative for near-term crypto risk sentiment and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Bitmine's Ethereum bet nears $9 billion loss as ether falls below $1,800
Crypto.reason: Large leveraged exposure and near-massive losses tied to a single player increases contagion risk in derivatives/venue plumbing — negative for ETH and systemic risk perception.

Crypto.title: Apyx's STRC collateralized stablecoin suffers a brief depeg. Protocol says its a feature, not bug
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin depegs undermine confidence in on-chain settlement rails and can force deleveraging/liquidity runs — negative for market stability and short-term flows.

Crypto.title: Bank of England faces calls from UK lawmakers to ease stablecoin plans
Crypto.reason: Political push to soften BoE stablecoin rules would be supportive for industry growth and issuance in the UK — positive regulatory signal, moderate relevance to structural adoption.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin Can't Compete With the AI Trade
Crypto.reason: Macro/flow narrative that capital is rotating into AI/tech trades at crypto's expense — a thematic headwind for crypto allocation, but more indirect than market-specific events.

Crypto.title: Every single bank will soon need to hold digital assets, says Zodia Custody CEO Julian Sawyer
Crypto.reason: Institutional custody demand and the Standard Chartered/Zodia development point to ongoing structural adoption of digital-asset infrastructure — positive long-term for crypto ecosystem demand.
